profile.headline: Cloud infrastructure and software engineer with deep expertise in designing distributed systems across cloud and on-premises datacenters
profile.summary:
Cloud infrastructure and software engineer with deep expertise in designing and optimizing distributed
systems. At Samsung, led the Cloud Platform team in building and operating cloud infrastructure
services across cloud and on-premises datacenters. Developed Kubernetes platforms, observability solutions, infrastructure as code, Ceph Storage, and GenAI services. At AT&T, developed
Kubernetes-orchestrated Ceph storage and Redis in-memory databases. Also, designed and implemented network systems for OpenStack clusters. Holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science with a focus on virtualization (QEMU-KVM), software-defined networking (SDN), and systems performance optimization.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Iselin, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developed a unified observability stack across on-premises (OpenShift) and public cloud (AKS) environments by deploying Grafana Alloy and Splunk OpenTelemetry Collectors via Helm charts
- Developed enterprise-scale Kubernetes monitoring with Grafana Mimir and Alertmanager, reducing noise by correlating cluster, node, and pod alerts into consolidated BigPanda/ServiceNow incidents
- Implemented and deployed a persistent queuing feature that buffers metrics to disk before forwarding to Grafana Cloud, delivering up to two hours of resiliency
- Reduced costs by identifying and eliminating 22M metric time series (12%) across 400+ Kubernetes clusters
- Deployed production changes through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions integrated with Harness and GitOps

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Platform Development (Kubernetes, Observability, IaC, GitOps, and Ceph)
- Developed HA Kubernetes services by deploying control plane components (i.e., kube-apiserver, scheduler, controller-manager, and etcd) behind a load balancer in a dedicated management cluster
- Developed a Kubernetes monitoring solution using Prometheus, integrating kube-state-metrics, kubelet, and node-exporter to deliver cluster, node, and container observability
- Developed infrastructure as code for Azure and AWS using ARM template, Bicep, and Terraform
- Deployed Kubernetes with Cilium to apply L7 network policies
- Automated application deployments on Kubernetes clusters with Argo CD
- Deployed Ceph storage to Kubernetes with Rook

GenAI Service Development
- Developed an LLM-powered multi-agent chat service using ReAct and RAG (w/ LangChain and LangGraph)
- Developed scalable microservices on Kubernetes leveraging vLLM for LLM inference

Technical Leadership
- As Head of Cloud Platform, led the group and defined MBOs and KPIs for the following projects:
1. Software development – HA Kubernetes service, HPC batch scheduler, and cloud cost monitoring system;
2. System engineering – VMware VM/VDI services, OpenStack VM service, and VM Backup/restore (w/ Veeam);
3. Public cloud architecture – Azure/AWS governance framework (landing zone) and AWS Outposts evaluation.
- Led team growth from 30 to over 60 engineers (SW/DevOps Engineers and Cloud Architects)
- Operated 24/7 infrastructure services at 99.95% SLO, supporting 5K+ VMs, 10K+ VDIs, 10K+ HPC servers, 500+ node Kubernetes clusters, and Active Directory for 60K+ users
positions.insights: Skills: Grafana · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · Kubernetes · Python (Programming Language) · Terraform · Bicep (Domain-Specific Language) · Amazon EKS · Ansible · Prometheus.io · OpenTelemetry · Inftrasructure as code · ARM Template · DevOps · GitOps · operator sdk · gRPC · Large Language Models (LLM) · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Multi-agent Systems · LangChain

positions.title: Principal Inventive Scientist
positions.locationName: Bedminster, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Kubernetes & Observability
- Designed and implemented containerized Ceph with Kubernetes helm charts (with an one-osd-per-pod approach)
- Developed real-time monitoring systems for containerized Ceph with Telegraf, InfluxDB, and Grafana
- Developed best recovery practices from various failure scenarios for containerized Ceph storage with Kubernetes
- Designed and implemented Redis High Availability with Kubernetes in CI/CD environment (Gerrit and Jenkins)
- Integrated Redis HA helm charts into Radio Access Network Intelligent Controller release 4 (field trial version)

Distributed Storage Systems
- Designed and implemented I/O traffic protection mechanisms for cloud storage
- Designed and implemented an iSCSI block storage backend with a commodity SSDs for OpenStack clusters
- Designed and implemented the backend of OpenStack Cinder for dynamic configuration and QoS support
- Evaluated cache performance across host and VM page cache, dm-cache, and Ceph RBD cache
- Evaluated the latency of Redis with Intel Optane Persistent Memory using the memtier_benchmark tool
- Evaluated and compared the performance of Redis vs Aerospike vs Cassandra using the YCSB benchmark tool
- Designed and implemented high-performance VMs by applying CPU pinning and SR-IOV PCI passthrough

Networked Systems
- Designed and implemented a system that dynamically controls network bandwidth and latency between OpenStack Neutron deployments with Ansible (using Open vSwitch and Tc/NetEm)
- Set up a testbed for RoCE-based lossless networks (using PFC-capable Mellanox Spectrum Switch and ConnectX-5 NICs) and evaluated the performance of NVMe over Fabric for zero CPU usage on the target host machine
- Evaluating the performance of Apache Traffic Server with Intel Optane Persistent Memory
- Analyzed cost benefits by applying Intel Optane Persistent Memory to AT&T’s Content Delivery Network (CDN)
positions.insights: Skills: Grafana · Kubernetes · Python (Programming Language) · Ansible

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
For my PhD research, I have built a network emulation framework for evaluating distributed applications running on diverse OSs (Linux, FreeBSD, Windows, JunOS). I modified the QEMU-KVM hypervisor to synchronize distributed VMs with virtual time.
– Hybrid Simulation and Emulation Framework, 2014
– Network Link Emulation with Adaptive Time Dilation, 2013
– High-Performance Emulation of Heterogeneous Systems, 2010–2012

I was a TA in Operating System (2010/2012/2013), Computer Networks (2011/2012/2013), Internet Protocols (2014), Algorithm (2011), and Software Engineering (2010).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
– Network Capacity Planning for Internet Backbone and IPTV Services with OPNET, 2007–2009
– Development of Network Management Systems for Internet Backbone and VoIP Service Networks, 2002–2006
